decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to use the Affinity mechanic to quickly flood the board with artifacts and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards that allow for cheap or free casting of artifacts, along with removal and card draw, the deck aims to maintain a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The synergy between artifacts and sacrifice effects like Deadly Dispute and Krark-Clan Shaman provides the deck with resilience and versatility in various matchups. With a focus on speed and efficiency, the deck aims to close out games swiftly.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to establish early board presence and tempo by utilizing cheap and efficient creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Brinebarrow Intruder. By combining disruptive countermagic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce with evasive threats such as Ninja of the Deep Hours, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of card draw spells like Of One Mind and Snap helps to keep the aggression going and ensure a steady stream of threats.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost aggressive creatures and efficient burn spells. By using cards like Goblin Bushwhacker and Reckless Lackey, the goal is to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent's life total. Cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast provide additional reach to close out games. The deck also has synergy with artifacts, such as Clockwork Percussionist and Experimental Synthesizer, to further enhance its aggro strategy. Overall, the deck aims to establish early board presence and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck revolves around generating value through sacrificing creatures and drawing cards with effects like Deadly Dispute and Malevolent Rumble. The Sadistic Glee enchantment plays a key role in boosting creatures and gaining advantage from sacrificing them. The deck also includes removal spells like Duress and Eviscerator's Insight to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The combo-oriented playstyle aims to overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and efficient creature sacrifice synergies, using cards like Basking Broodscale and Shambling Ghast to fuel the strategy.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing card draw and graveyard manipulation to fuel its game plan. With a mix of cheap removal, powerful finishers like Gurmag Angler, and efficient counterspells, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run. The inclusion of cards like Thought Scour and Deep Analysis helps to dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage, while also setting up for powerful plays.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play artifact creatures and utilize various spells and artifacts to generate card advantage and deal damage to the opponent. The deck makes use of cards that can sacrifice artifacts for benefits, along with removal spells and additional resources to maintain pressure on the opponent. By capitalizing on the synergy between artifacts and sacrifice effects, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient strategy.

The main idea of this Red Deck Wins aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures and burn spells. Using low-cost creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Clockwork Percussionist, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Voldaren Epicure provide additional utility and value. The deck is focused on playing aggressively, utilizing its speed and efficiency to win games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to generate value and trigger effects, ultimately aiming to assemble a combo that leads to a game-winning play. The strategy involves utilizing cards like Sadistic Glee and Deadly Dispute to sacrifice creatures, while also using cards like Malevolent Rumble and Basking Broodscale for additional synergy. Manor Gate and Twisted Landscape provide additional utility, while Tamiyo's Safekeeping offers protection for key pieces of the combo. The overall goal is to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent with a devastating combo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures like Stinkweed Imp and Satyr Wayfinder, then use cards like Exhume and Dread Return to bring them back onto the battlefield for powerful combos and reanimation effects. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures like Lotleth Giant and Rubblebelt Maverick, while also using cards like Malevolent Rumble and Generous Ent for added value. The mana base includes a mix of lands to ensure consistency in casting the key spells needed to execute the reanimation strategy effectively.

This deck focuses on creating a fast-paced aggressive strategy using low-cost creatures and disruption spells to control the tempo of the game. By utilizing creatures like Brinebarrow Intruder, Faerie Seer, and Moon-Circuit Hacker alongside counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The inclusion of card draw spells like Of One Mind and powerful creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours allow for sustained pressure and card advantage. The deck also includes evasion abilities and bounce effects to maintain board presence and outmaneuver opponents.

The deck focuses on using cheap artifacts to ramp up mana quickly and enable powerful synergies. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle, using cards like Galvanic Blast and Myr Enforcer to deal direct damage and control the board. The combination of affinity cards and artifact creatures allows for explosive turns and constant pressure on the opponent. Utilizing efficient removal spells like Cast Down and Krark-Clan Shaman helps to maintain the deck's tempo and disrupt the opponent's strategies. Overall, the deck excels at applying early pressure and maintaining a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creature cards and direct damage spells. By using low-cost creatures like Clockwork Percussionist and Goblin Blast-Runner, combined with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, this deck aims to reduce the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Great Furnace allow for a fast start and the ability to swing for significant damage early on. The inclusion of cards like Implement of Combustion and Voldaren Epicure also provide additional reach and board presence.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents and controlling the pace of the game through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card draw. It aims to maintain board control and outvalue opponents by using efficient spells and creatures to control the game's tempo. The deck also utilizes card advantage and versatile creatures like Spellstutter Sprite and Ninja of the Deep Hours to generate advantage while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes utility lands to further enhance the control strategy.

The deck focuses on flooding the battlefield with low-cost white creatures to swarm the opponent and overwhelm them with numbers. It also includes spells to buff the creatures and protect them from removal spells or combat. The goal is to maintain aggression and pressure the opponent constantly, forcing them to react and eventually run out of resources. The deck's strategy relies on a fast and relentless assault, using synergies between creatures and spells to create a powerful board presence and secure victory.

The main idea of this Pauper Dimir Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card draw. Use cards like Contaminated Aquifer and Tolarian Terror to disrupt your opponent's strategy, while utilizing powerful spells like Snuff Out and Gurmag Angler to deal with threats. Brainstorm, Deep Analysis, and Thought Scour provide card advantage and enable you to dig deeper into your deck for key cards. With a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw, this deck aims to outlast opponents and win through attrition.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy by utilizing low-cost creatures and artifacts to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The deck also includes cards that provide card advantage and removal spells to control the board. By efficiently utilizing the artifacts and creatures in combination with removal spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through aggressive plays and efficient use of resources.
